{{Quote|I need a set of booster coils for a SoroSuub V-Twenty-Four, and don’t try to rob me. I know your reputation.|Cliegg Lars to Watto|<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>}}
'''Booster Coils''' were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] components installed on [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[V-24 landspeeder]]<ref name="TG" /> and [[V-35 Courier/Legends|V-35 Courier]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. Two Booster Coils were on the craft, nestled between the three thrust [[Turbine/Legends|turbines]].<ref name="EGVV" />
